newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes lower on overseas trend.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes lower on overseas trend.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed lower against its U.S. counterpart on Wednesday, reflecting the greenback's strength in overseas markets, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.557 against Tuesday's T$27.540 close.
Turnover through dealers was a hectic US$380 million.
Earlier in the session the Taiwan dollar had dropped to an intra-session low of T$27.588 following the American currency's recent sharp gains against the Japanese yen and the German mark.
Dealers suspected the central bank had intervened to prevent a sharper loss by the local dollar.
"I think the central bank did not want to see such a wide fluctuation, so it sold some U.S. dollars to defend the local currency," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers expected Taiwan's foreign exchange market to continue tracking the U.S. dollar's movement overseas. A T$27.55-60 range was seen for Thursday.
